name: Arthur Mensch
bio: Arthur Mensch is a French AI researcher and co-founder and chief executive of Mistral AI. Before founding the company in 2023 with Guillaume Lample and Timothée Lacroix, Mensch worked at DeepMind Paris on large language models. Earlier research covered optimization, optimal transport and brain imaging analysis.
known_for: Co-author of the Chinchilla compute-optimal training paper
Research on stochastic optimization and functional MRI analysis
